```{r}
# math.R

logistic <- function(x) {
  1 / (1 + exp(-x))
}

log_sum_exp <- function(x) {
  x.max <- max(x);
  log(sum(exp(x - x.max))) + x.max
}
```

```{r}
# stats.R

# E[x] under a beta distribution
expect_x_beta <- function(param) {
  with(param, a / (a + b))
}

# E[log(x)] under a beta distribution
expect_log_x_beta <- function(param) {
  with(param, digamma(a) - digamma(a + b))
}

# E[log(1-x)] under a beta distribution
expect_log_1mx_beta <- function(param) {
  with(param, digamma(b) - digamma(a + b))
}

# -E[log q] for a Bernoulli distribution, with direct parameterization
entropy_bern_d <- function(prob) {
  log_q_zero <- ifelse(prob == 1, 0, -(1 - prob) * log(1 - prob));
  log_q_one <- ifelse(prob == 0, 0, -prob * log(prob));
  sum(log_q_zero + log_q_one)
}

# elementwise version of -E[log q] for a Bernoulli distribution
bern_h <- function(prob) {
  out <- numeric(length(prob));
  idx_positive <- prob > 0;
  idx_less_than_one <- prob < 1;
  out[idx_positive] <- out[idx_positive] - prob[idx_positive] * log(prob[idx_positive]);
  out[idx_less_than_one] <- out[idx_less_than_one] - (1 - prob[idx_less_than_one]) * log(1 - prob[idx_less_than_one]);
  dim(out) <- dim(prob);
  out
}

# multiplier * log(log_argument)
x_log_y <- function(multiplier, log_argument) {
  stopifnot(length(multiplier) == length(log_argument));
  out <- numeric(length(multiplier));
  idx_nonzero <- multiplier != 0;
  out[idx_nonzero] <- multiplier[idx_nonzero] * log(log_argument[idx_nonzero]);
  dim(out) <- dim(multiplier);
  out
}

# E[log p(theta)] - E[log q(theta)] for Beta
beta_prior_minus_q <- function(variational_beta_param, prior_alpha, prior_beta) {
  expect_log_theta <- expect_log_x_beta(variational_beta_param);
  expect_log_one_minus_theta <- expect_log_1mx_beta(variational_beta_param);
  with(variational_beta_param, sum(-lbeta(prior_alpha, prior_beta) + lbeta(a, b) + (prior_alpha - a) * 
                                     expect_log_theta + (prior_beta - b) * expect_log_one_minus_theta))
}

# E[log p(a)] - E[log q(a)] for Gamma(alpha, alpha)
gamma_prior_minus_q <- function(variational_gamma_param, alpha) {
  with(variational_gamma_param, {
    expect_log_a <- digamma(a) - log(b);
    expect_a <- a / b;
    sum(-lgamma(alpha) + alpha * log(alpha) + lgamma(a) - a * log(b) + (alpha - a) * expect_log_a - alpha * expect_a + a)})
}
```

```{r}
# preprocess.R

# preprocess x, u, and K
prepare_data <- function(data) {
  if (is.null(data$x) || is.null(data$u) || is.null(data$K)) {
    stop("data must contain x, u, and K.");
  }
  
  x <- as.matrix(data$x);
  u <- as.matrix(data$u);
  storage.mode(x) <- "double";
  storage.mode(u) <- "double";
  
  data$x <- x;
  data$u <- u;
  data$N <- nrow(x);
  data$J <- ncol(x);
  data$K <- as.integer(data$K);
  
  structure(data, class="exprsim_vi_data")
}

# initialize variational parameters
prepare_params <- function(params0, data, hparams) {
  if (is.null(params0)) {
    params0 <- list();
  }
  
  N <- data$N;
  J <- data$J;
  K <- data$K;
  
  vparams <- list(
    a = list(
      a = if (is.null(params0$a_a)) matrix(hparams$alpha, N, K) else as.matrix(params0$a_a),
      b = if (is.null(params0$a_b)) matrix(hparams$alpha, N, K) else as.matrix(params0$a_b)
    ),
    psi = list(a = rep(hparams$alpha_psi, K), b = rep(hparams$beta_psi, K)),
    phi = list(a = rep(hparams$alpha_phi, J), b = rep(hparams$beta_phi, J)),
    eta = list(a = rep(hparams$alpha_eta, J), b = rep(hparams$beta_eta, J)),
    beta_delta = list(
      mu_beta = if (is.null(params0$mu_beta)) {
        matrix(0, K, J)
      } else {
        as.matrix(params0$mu_beta)
      },
      sigma2_beta = if (is.null(params0$sigma2_beta)) {
        matrix(1 / hparams$tau, K, J)
      } else {
        as.matrix(params0$sigma2_beta)
      }
    ),
    z = list(a = matrix(1, N, J), b = matrix(hparams$gamma, N, J))
  );
  
  # initial E[delta_kj] = E[psi_k] E[phi_j]
  if (is.null(params0$expect_delta)) {
    expect_psi <- expect_x_beta(vparams$psi);
    expect_phi <- expect_x_beta(vparams$phi);
    expect_delta <- outer(expect_psi, expect_phi, "*");
  } else {
    expect_delta <- as.matrix(params0$expect_delta);
  }
  
  # initial E[v_ij] = E[eta_j], with v_ij = 1 when x_ij > 0
  if (is.null(params0$expect_v)) {
    expect_eta <- expect_x_beta(vparams$eta);
    expect_v <- matrix(rep(expect_eta, each=N), N, J);
    expect_v[data$x > 0] <- 1;
  } else {
    expect_v <- as.matrix(params0$expect_v);
    expect_v[data$x > 0] <- 1;
  }
  
  # initial auxiliary tangent parameter for the z lower bound
  if (is.null(params0$xi_z)) {
    xi_z <- matrix(hparams$rho, N, J) + (1 - data$u) / hparams$gamma;
  } else {
    xi_z <- as.matrix(params0$xi_z);
  }
  
  # initial auxiliary parameter for the delta Jensen lower bound
  if (is.null(params0$xi_delta)) {
    expect_log_psi <- expect_log_x_beta(vparams$psi);
    expect_log_one_minus_psi <- expect_log_1mx_beta(vparams$psi);
    expect_log_one_minus_phi <- expect_log_1mx_beta(vparams$phi);
    xi_delta <- logistic(outer(expect_log_one_minus_psi - expect_log_psi, expect_log_one_minus_phi, "-"));
  } else {
    xi_delta <- as.matrix(params0$xi_delta);
  }
  
  a_a <- vparams$a$a;
  b_a <- vparams$a$b;
  expect_a <- a_a / b_a;
  expect_a2 <- a_a * (a_a + 1) / (b_a^2);
  expect_log_a <- digamma(a_a) - log(b_a);
  
  mu_beta <- vparams$beta_delta$mu_beta;
  sigma2_beta <- vparams$beta_delta$sigma2_beta;
  expect_delta_beta <- expect_delta * mu_beta;
  expect_delta_beta2 <- expect_delta * (mu_beta^2 + sigma2_beta);
  
  expect_log_m <- ((1 - data$u[, seq_len(K), drop=FALSE]) * expect_a) %*% expect_delta_beta;
  
  params <- list(
    expect_a = expect_a,
    expect_a2 = expect_a2,
    expect_log_a = expect_log_a,
    expect_delta = expect_delta,
    expect_delta_beta = expect_delta_beta,
    expect_delta_beta2 = expect_delta_beta2,
    expect_beta = expect_delta_beta,
    expect_beta2 = (1 - expect_delta) / hparams$tau + expect_delta_beta2,
    expect_log_m = expect_log_m,
    expect_m = exp(expect_log_m),
    expect_v = expect_v,
    xi_z = xi_z,
    xi_delta = xi_delta
  );
  
  list(params = params, vparams = vparams)
}

# decide which variational blocks are fixed during VI
prepare_fixed <- function(fixed) {
  if (is.null(fixed)) {
    fixed <- list();
  }
  
  for (block_name in c("a", "beta_delta", "z_v", "eta", "psi", "phi")) {
    if (is.null(fixed[[block_name]])) {
      fixed[[block_name]] <- FALSE;
    }
  }
  
  fixed
}
```

```{r}
# exprsim_vi.R

# fit the ExprSim variational model
exprsim_vi <- function(data, hparams, model=NULL, tol=1e-2, max.iter=2000, verbose=1) {
  if (is.null(model)) {
    fit <- exprsim_vi_local(data=data, hparams=hparams, verbose=verbose, tol=tol, max.iter=max.iter);
  } else {
    stopifnot(is(model, "exprsim_vi_fit"));
    fit <- exprsim_vi_local(model=model, verbose=verbose, tol=tol, max.iter=max.iter);
  }
  fit
}

# initialize an exprsim_vi_fit object
make_model <- function(data, params0=NULL, hparams) {
  if (!is(data, "exprsim_vi_data")) {
    data <- prepare_data(data);
  }
  
  prepared_params <- prepare_params(params0, data, hparams);

  model <- list(data = data,
                params = c(prepared_params$params, hparams),
                vparams = prepared_params$vparams,
                elbo = numeric(0),
                elbo_trace = data.frame());
  
  # expected log Beta
  model$params$expect_log_psi <- expect_log_x_beta(model$vparams$psi);
  model$params$expect_log_one_minus_psi <- expect_log_1mx_beta(model$vparams$psi);
  
  model$params$expect_log_phi <- expect_log_x_beta(model$vparams$phi);
  model$params$expect_log_one_minus_phi <- expect_log_1mx_beta(model$vparams$phi);
  
  model$params$expect_log_eta <- expect_log_x_beta(model$vparams$eta);
  model$params$expect_log_one_minus_eta <- expect_log_1mx_beta(model$vparams$eta);
  
  # initialize auxiliary quantities and variational blocks
  model <- update_xi_delta(model);
  model <- update_q_z_v(model);
  model <- update_xi_z(model);
  model <- update_q_eta(model);
  
  structure(model, class="exprsim_vi_fit")
}

# predict expression counts
predict.exprsim_vi_fit <- function(object, u_new, a_new=object$params$expect_a) {
  N <- nrow(a_new);
  J <- object$data$J;
  K <- object$data$K;
  
  expect_n_new <- ((1 - u_new[, seq_len(K), drop=FALSE]) * a_new) %*% object$params$expect_delta_beta;
  expect_m_new <- exp(expect_n_new);
  expect_eta <- expect_x_beta(object$vparams$eta);
  expect_x <- (1 - u_new) * expect_m_new * matrix(expect_eta, nrow=N, ncol=J, byrow=TRUE);
  
  expect_x
}

# extract beta means
coef.exprsim_vi_fit <- function(object, par=c("delta", "beta_mu", "beta_mean")) {
  par <- match.arg(par);
  
  if (par == "delta") {
    return(object$params$expect_delta);
  }
  
  if (par == "beta_mu") {
    return(object$vparams$beta_delta$mu_beta);
  }
  
  object$params$expect_beta
}

# print fitted model
print.exprsim_vi_fit <- function(object) {
  niters <- length(object$elbo);
  
  elbo_value <- if (niters > 0) {
    object$elbo[niters]
  } else {
    elbo(object)
  }
  
  cat("\nExprSim variational model\n\n");
  cat("ELBO lower bound: ", elbo_value, ",  niters: ", niters, "\n", sep="");
}
```

```{r}
# model.R

# find a local maximum for VI
exprsim_vi_local <- function(data=NULL, hparams=NULL, params0=NULL, fixed=NULL, model=NULL, verbose=1, max.iter=1000, tol=0.001) {
  if (is.null(data) && is.null(model)) {
    stop("Input data must be provided unless a previously fitted model is given.");
  }
  
  if (is.null(model)) {
    model <- make_model(data, params0, hparams);
  } else {
    stopifnot(is(model, "exprsim_vi_fit"));
  }
  
  model$fixed <- prepare_fixed(fixed);
  
  niters <- 0;
  previous_elbo <- elbo(model);
  
  # ELBO change
  delta_elbo <- Inf;
  elbos <- rep(NA, max.iter);
  
  # record initial ELBO
  initial_components <- elbo_components(model);
  
  model$elbo_trace <- rbind(
    model$elbo_trace,
    data.frame(
      iteration = 0,
      step = "initial",
      elbo = initial_components$total,
      delta = NA,
      z = initial_components$z,
      v_eta = initial_components$v_eta,
      beta_delta = initial_components$beta_delta,
      psi = initial_components$psi,
      phi = initial_components$phi,
      eta = initial_components$eta,
      a = initial_components$a,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  );
  
  # convergence and stopping rule
  while ((!is.finite(delta_elbo) || abs(delta_elbo) > tol) && niters < max.iter) {
    niters <- niters + 1;
    step_elbo <- previous_elbo;
    
    # q(beta,delta): Taylor approximation
    if (!model$fixed$beta_delta) {
      model <- update_q_beta_delta(model);
      trace_result <- append_elbo_trace(model, niters, "q(beta,delta)", step_elbo, verbose = verbose);
      model <- trace_result$model;
      step_elbo <- trace_result$elbo;
    }
    
    # q(a): Taylor approximation
    if (!model$fixed$a) {
      model <- update_q_a(model);
      trace_result <- append_elbo_trace(model, niters, "q(a)", step_elbo, verbose = verbose);
      model <- trace_result$model;
      step_elbo <- trace_result$elbo;
    }
    
    # q(z,v)
    if (!model$fixed$z_v) {
      model <- update_q_z_v(model);
      trace_result <- append_elbo_trace(model, niters, "q(z,v)", step_elbo, verbose = verbose);
      model <- trace_result$model;
      step_elbo <- trace_result$elbo;
    }
    
    # xi_ij
    model <- update_xi_z(model);
    trace_result <- append_elbo_trace(model, niters, "xi_z", step_elbo, verbose = verbose);
    model <- trace_result$model;
    step_elbo <- trace_result$elbo;
    
    # q(eta)
    if (!model$fixed$eta) {
      model <- update_q_eta(model);
      trace_result <- append_elbo_trace(model, niters, "q(eta)", step_elbo, verbose = verbose);
      model <- trace_result$model;
      step_elbo <- trace_result$elbo;
    }
    
    # q(psi)
    if (!model$fixed$psi) {
      model <- update_q_psi(model);
      trace_result <- append_elbo_trace(model, niters, "q(psi)", step_elbo, verbose = verbose);
      model <- trace_result$model;
      step_elbo <- trace_result$elbo;
    }
    
    # xi_kj after q(psi)
    model <- update_xi_delta(model);
    trace_result <- append_elbo_trace(model, niters, "xi_delta_after_psi", step_elbo, verbose = verbose);
    model <- trace_result$model;
    step_elbo <- trace_result$elbo;
    
    # q(phi)
    if (!model$fixed$phi) {
      model <- update_q_phi(model);
      trace_result <- append_elbo_trace(model, niters, "q(phi)", step_elbo, verbose = verbose);
      model <- trace_result$model;
      step_elbo <- trace_result$elbo;
    }
    
    # xi_kj after q(phi)
    model <- update_xi_delta(model);
    trace_result <- append_elbo_trace(model, niters, "xi_delta_after_phi", step_elbo, verbose = verbose);
    model <- trace_result$model;
    step_elbo <- trace_result$elbo;

    current_elbo <- step_elbo;
    delta_elbo <- current_elbo - previous_elbo;
    elbos[niters] <- current_elbo;
    
    if (verbose >= 3) {
      message("update iteration: ", niters, ",  elbo: ", current_elbo);
      
      if (verbose >= 4) {
        message("delta elbo: ", delta_elbo);
      }
    }
    
    previous_elbo <- current_elbo;
  }
  
  if (verbose >= 2) {
    message("elapsed iterations: ", niters);
  }
  
  if (niters > 0) {
    model$elbo <- c(model$elbo, elbos[seq_len(niters)]);
  }
  
  model
}

# update q(a_ik) (4.1)
update_q_a <- function(model) {
  K <- model$data$K;
  u <- model$data$u;
  gamma <- model$params$gamma;
  alpha <- model$params$alpha;
  
  expect_log_z_given_v_one <- digamma(model$vparams$z$a) - log(model$vparams$z$b);
  expect_v <- model$params$expect_v;
  expect_delta_beta <- model$params$expect_delta_beta;
  expect_delta_beta2 <- model$params$expect_delta_beta2;
  expect_n <- model$params$expect_log_m;
  
  one_minus_u_sq <- (1 - u[, seq_len(K), drop = FALSE])^2;
  var_n <- (one_minus_u_sq * model$params$expect_a2) %*% expect_delta_beta2 - (one_minus_u_sq * model$params$expect_a^2) %*% (expect_delta_beta^2);
  
  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    gamma_exp_expect_n <- gamma * exp(expect_n);
    
    if (any(!is.finite(gamma_exp_expect_n)) || any(gamma_exp_expect_n <= 0)) {
      stop("Non-finite gamma*exp(E[n]) in q(a) update.");
    }
    
    # f'(E[n]), f''(E[n]), f'''(E[n])
    psi0 <- digamma(gamma_exp_expect_n);
    psi1 <- trigamma(gamma_exp_expect_n);
    psi2 <- psigamma(gamma_exp_expect_n, deriv = 2);
    
    f_first <- expect_v * gamma_exp_expect_n * (log(gamma) + expect_log_z_given_v_one - psi0);
    f_second <- f_first - expect_v * (gamma_exp_expect_n^2) * psi1;
    f_third <- f_second - expect_v * (gamma_exp_expect_n^2) * (2 * psi1 + gamma_exp_expect_n * psi2);
    
    one_minus_u_k <- 1 - u[, k];
    one_minus_u_k_sq <- one_minus_u_k * one_minus_u_k;
    old_expect_a_k <- model$params$expect_a[, k];
    old_expect_a2_k <- model$params$expect_a2[, k];
    
    ed_beta_k <- expect_delta_beta[k, ];
    ed_beta2_k <- expect_delta_beta2[k, ];
    
    # B_{ik} and C_{ik}
    B_k <- -alpha + one_minus_u_k * as.vector((f_first + 0.5 * f_third * var_n) %*% ed_beta_k) -
      one_minus_u_k_sq * old_expect_a_k * as.vector(f_second %*% (ed_beta_k^2));
    C_k <- one_minus_u_k_sq * as.vector(f_second %*% ed_beta2_k);
    
    # solve g(a_{a_{ik}}) = 0 via Newton's method
    mu0 <- (2 * alpha) / (-B_k + sqrt(B_k^2 - 4 * alpha * C_k * (1 + 1 / model$vparams$a$a[, k])));
    a_a_k <- alpha - C_k * mu0^2;
    
    for (it in seq_len(10)) {
      S <- sqrt(B_k^2 - 4 * alpha * C_k * (1 + 1 / a_a_k));
      mu <- (2 * alpha) / (-B_k + S);
      p1 <- trigamma(a_a_k);
      p2 <- psigamma(a_a_k, deriv = 2);
      t <- (a_a_k^2) * p1 - a_a_k;
      
      g <- (alpha - a_a_k) * t - 0.5 * C_k * mu^2;
      g_deriv <- -t + (alpha - a_a_k) * (2 * a_a_k * p1 + (a_a_k^2) * p2 - 1) + (C_k^2 * mu^3) / ((a_a_k^2) * S);
      
      step <- g / g_deriv;
      a_a_k <- a_a_k - step;
      if (isTRUE(max(abs(step) / a_a_k) < 1e-10)) break;
    }
    
    # b_{a_{ik}}
    new_expect_a_k <- (2 * alpha) / (-B_k + sqrt(B_k^2 - 4 * alpha * C_k * (1 + 1 / a_a_k)));
    b_a_k <- a_a_k / new_expect_a_k;
    
    if (any(!is.finite(a_a_k)) || any(a_a_k <= 0) || any(!is.finite(b_a_k)) || any(b_a_k <= 0)) {
      stop("Taylor q(a) is not normalizable at k=", k, ".");
    }
    
    new_expect_a2_k <- a_a_k * (a_a_k + 1) / (b_a_k^2);
    
    model$vparams$a$a[, k] <- a_a_k;
    model$vparams$a$b[, k] <- b_a_k;
    model$params$expect_a[, k] <- new_expect_a_k;
    model$params$expect_a2[, k] <- new_expect_a2_k;
    model$params$expect_log_a[, k] <- digamma(a_a_k) - log(b_a_k);
    
    # update E[n] and Var(n)
    expect_n <- expect_n + outer(one_minus_u_k * (new_expect_a_k - old_expect_a_k), ed_beta_k, "*");
    var_n <- var_n +
      outer(one_minus_u_k_sq * (new_expect_a2_k - old_expect_a2_k), ed_beta2_k, "*") -
      outer(one_minus_u_k_sq * (new_expect_a_k^2 - old_expect_a_k^2), ed_beta_k^2, "*");
  }
  
  model$params$expect_log_m <- expect_n;
  model$params$expect_m <- exp(expect_n);
  model
}

# update the Jensen auxiliary parameter xi_kj (4.2)
update_xi_delta <- function(model) {
  model$params$xi_delta <- logistic(
    outer(model$params$expect_log_one_minus_psi - model$params$expect_log_psi, 
          model$params$expect_log_one_minus_phi, "-")
  );
  
  model
}

# update the tangent auxiliary parameter xi_ij (4.5.2)
update_xi_z <- function(model) {
  model$params$xi_z <- model$params$rho + (1 - model$data$u) * (model$vparams$z$a / model$vparams$z$b);
  
  model
}

# update q(beta_kj, delta_kj) (4.6)
update_q_beta_delta <- function(model) {
  K <- model$data$K;
  u <- model$data$u;
  gamma <- model$params$gamma;
  tau <- model$params$tau;
  
  expect_log_z_given_v_one <- digamma(model$vparams$z$a) - log(model$vparams$z$b);
  expect_v <- model$params$expect_v;
  expect_n <- model$params$expect_log_m;
  
  one_minus_u <- 1 - u[, seq_len(K), drop=FALSE];
  C1_ik <- one_minus_u * model$params$expect_a;
  C1_ik_sq <- C1_ik * C1_ik;
  C2_ik <- (one_minus_u^2) * model$params$expect_a2;
  
  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    gamma_exp_expect_n <- gamma * exp(expect_n);
    
    if (any(!is.finite(gamma_exp_expect_n)) || any(gamma_exp_expect_n <= 0)) {
      stop("Non-finite gamma*exp(E[n]) in q(beta,delta) update.");
    }
    
    # first and second derivatives f'(E[n]) and f''(E[n])
    f_first <- expect_v * gamma_exp_expect_n * (log(gamma) + expect_log_z_given_v_one - digamma(gamma_exp_expect_n));
    f_second <- expect_v * gamma_exp_expect_n * (log(gamma) + expect_log_z_given_v_one - digamma(gamma_exp_expect_n) -
                                                   gamma_exp_expect_n * trigamma(gamma_exp_expect_n));
    
    old_expect_delta_beta <- model$params$expect_delta_beta[k, ];
    C1_k <- C1_ik[, k];
    C1_k_sq <- C1_ik_sq[, k];
    C2_k <- C2_ik[, k];
    
    # sigma_{beta_kj}^2
    precision_beta <- tau - as.vector(crossprod(C2_k, f_second));
    
    if (any(!is.finite(precision_beta)) || any(precision_beta <= 0)) {
      stop("Taylor q(beta,delta) is not normalizable at k=", k, ".");
    }
    
    sigma2_beta <- 1 / precision_beta;
    
    # mu_{beta_kj}
    mu_beta <- sigma2_beta * (as.vector(crossprod(C1_k, f_first)) - old_expect_delta_beta * as.vector(crossprod(C1_k_sq, f_second)));
    
    # Jensen auxiliary parameter
    xi_delta <- model$params$xi_delta[k, ];
    H_xi_delta <- bern_h(xi_delta);
    
    # delta_kj = 0: log c_0
    log_c_zero <- xi_delta * model$params$expect_log_one_minus_psi[k] +
      (1 - xi_delta) * model$params$expect_log_psi[k] +
      (1 - xi_delta) * model$params$expect_log_one_minus_phi +
      H_xi_delta + 0.5 * (log(2 * pi) - log(tau));
    
    # delta_kj = 1: log c_1
    log_c_one <- model$params$expect_log_psi[k] + model$params$expect_log_phi +
      (mu_beta^2) / (2 * sigma2_beta) + 0.5 * log(2 * pi * sigma2_beta);
    
    # normalize the two weights
    max_val <- pmax(log_c_zero, log_c_one);
    log_denominator <- max_val + log(exp(log_c_zero - max_val) + exp(log_c_one - max_val));
    
    # E[delta_kj]
    expect_delta <- exp(log_c_one - log_denominator);
    
    # new q(beta,delta) parameters
    model$vparams$beta_delta$mu_beta[k, ] <- mu_beta;
    model$vparams$beta_delta$sigma2_beta[k, ] <- sigma2_beta;
    model$params$expect_delta[k, ] <- expect_delta;
    
    # E[delta_kj beta_kj], E[delta_kj beta_kj^2], and E[beta_kj^2]
    new_expect_delta_beta <- expect_delta * mu_beta;
    new_expect_delta_beta2 <- expect_delta * (mu_beta^2 + sigma2_beta);
    model$params$expect_delta_beta[k, ] <- new_expect_delta_beta;
    model$params$expect_delta_beta2[k, ] <- new_expect_delta_beta2;
    model$params$expect_beta[k, ] <- new_expect_delta_beta;
    model$params$expect_beta2[k, ] <- (1 - expect_delta) / tau + new_expect_delta_beta2;
    
    # update E[n]
    expect_n <- expect_n + outer(C1_k, new_expect_delta_beta - old_expect_delta_beta, "*");
  }
  
  model$params$expect_log_m <- expect_n;
  model$params$expect_m <- exp(expect_n);
  model
}

# update q(z_ij, v_ij) (4.5)
update_q_z_v <- function(model) {
  x <- model$data$x;
  u <- model$data$u;
  N <- model$data$N;
  J <- model$data$J;
  K <- model$data$K;
  gamma <- model$params$gamma;
  rho <- model$params$rho;
  xi_z <- model$params$xi_z;
  expect_m <- model$params$expect_m;
  gamma_expect_m <- gamma * expect_m;
  
  # Var(n)
  one_minus_u_sq <- (1 - u[, seq_len(K), drop = FALSE])^2;
  var_n <- (one_minus_u_sq * model$params$expect_a2) %*% model$params$expect_delta_beta2 -
    (one_minus_u_sq * (model$params$expect_a^2)) %*% (model$params$expect_delta_beta^2);
  
  # a_{z_{ij}}, b_{z_{ij}}
  a_z <- x + gamma_expect_m * (1 + 0.5 * var_n);
  b_z <- gamma + ((rho + x) * (1 - u)) / xi_z;
  
  if (
    any(!is.finite(a_z)) || any(a_z <= 0) ||
    any(!is.finite(b_z)) || any(b_z <= 0)
  ) {
    stop("Invalid Gamma parameters in q(z|v=1) update.");
  }
  
  model$vparams$z$a <- a_z;
  model$vparams$z$b <- b_z;
  
  expect_log_eta_matrix <- matrix(model$params$expect_log_eta, nrow = N, ncol = J, byrow = TRUE);
  
  # v_ij = 1: log c_1
  taylor_v1_extra <- 0.5 * var_n * gamma_expect_m * (log(gamma) - digamma(gamma_expect_m) - gamma_expect_m * trigamma(gamma_expect_m));
  
  log_c_one <- expect_log_eta_matrix - lgamma(gamma_expect_m) + gamma_expect_m * log(gamma) +
    taylor_v1_extra - (rho + x) * log(xi_z) - ((rho + x) * (rho - xi_z)) / xi_z + lgamma(a_z) - a_z * log(b_z);

  expect_v <- matrix(1, N, J); 
  zero_index <- which(x == 0, arr.ind=TRUE);
  
  if (nrow(zero_index) > 0) {
    zero_cols <- zero_index[, 2];
    
    # v_ij = 0: log c_0
    log_c_zero <- model$params$expect_log_one_minus_eta[zero_cols] - rho * log(rho);
    log_c_one_zero <- log_c_one[zero_index];
    
    max_val <- pmax(log_c_zero, log_c_one_zero);
    log_denominator <- max_val + log(exp(log_c_zero - max_val) + exp(log_c_one_zero - max_val));
    
    expect_v[zero_index] <- exp(log_c_one_zero - log_denominator);
  }
  
  model$params$expect_v <- expect_v; 
  model
}

# update q(eta_j) (4.4)
update_q_eta <- function(model) {
  model$vparams$eta <- list(a = model$params$alpha_eta + colSums(model$params$expect_v),
                            b = model$params$beta_eta + model$data$N - colSums(model$params$expect_v));
  model$params$expect_log_eta <- expect_log_x_beta(model$vparams$eta);
  model$params$expect_log_one_minus_eta <- expect_log_1mx_beta(model$vparams$eta);
  model
}

# update q(psi_k) (4.2)
update_q_psi <- function(model) {
  expect_delta <- model$params$expect_delta;
  xi_delta <- model$params$xi_delta;
  model$vparams$psi <- list(a = model$params$alpha_psi + rowSums(expect_delta + (1 - expect_delta) * (1 - xi_delta)),
                            b = model$params$beta_psi + rowSums((1 - expect_delta) * xi_delta));
  model$params$expect_log_psi <- expect_log_x_beta(model$vparams$psi);
  model$params$expect_log_one_minus_psi <- expect_log_1mx_beta(model$vparams$psi);
  model
}

# update q(phi_j) (4.3)
update_q_phi <- function(model) {
  expect_delta <- model$params$expect_delta;
  xi_delta <- model$params$xi_delta;
  model$vparams$phi <- list(a = model$params$alpha_phi + colSums(expect_delta),
                            b = model$params$beta_phi + colSums((1 - expect_delta) * (1 - xi_delta)));
  model$params$expect_log_phi <- expect_log_x_beta(model$vparams$phi);
  model$params$expect_log_one_minus_phi <- expect_log_1mx_beta(model$vparams$phi);
  model
}

# complete ELBO lower bound (5.12)
elbo_components <- function(model) {
  x <- model$data$x;
  u <- model$data$u;
  N <- model$data$N;
  J <- model$data$J;
  K <- model$data$K;
  
  with(model$params, {
    a_z <- model$vparams$z$a;
    b_z <- model$vparams$z$b;
    expect_log_z_given_v_one <- digamma(a_z) - log(b_z);
    expect_z_given_v_one <- a_z / b_z;
    
    # Section 5.2 and 5.12: f''(E[n]) and Var(n)
    gamma_exp_expect_n <- gamma * expect_m;
    f_second <- expect_v * gamma_exp_expect_n * (log(gamma) + expect_log_z_given_v_one - digamma(gamma_exp_expect_n) -
      gamma_exp_expect_n * trigamma(gamma_exp_expect_n));
    one_minus_u_sq <- (1 - u[, seq_len(K), drop=FALSE])^2;
    var_n <- (one_minus_u_sq * expect_a2) %*% expect_delta_beta2 - (one_minus_u_sq * (expect_a^2)) %*% (expect_delta_beta^2);
    
    # E[log p(x|z)] + E[log p(z|m,v)] - E[log q(z|v)]
    observation_constant <- lgamma(x + rho) - lgamma(x + 1) - lgamma(rho) + rho * log(rho) + x_log_y(x, 1 - u);
    observation_auxiliary <- -(rho + x) * log(xi_z) - ((rho + x) / xi_z) * (rho + (1 - u) * expect_z_given_v_one - xi_z);
    latent_shape_part <- -lgamma(gamma_exp_expect_n) + gamma_exp_expect_n * log(gamma);
    z_variational_part <- (x + gamma_exp_expect_n - a_z) * expect_log_z_given_v_one -
      gamma * expect_z_given_v_one - a_z * log(b_z) + lgamma(a_z) + a_z;
    
    z_block <- sum(0.5 * f_second * var_n + expect_v * (observation_constant + observation_auxiliary + latent_shape_part + z_variational_part));
    
    # E[log p(v|eta)] - E[log q(v)]
    v_eta_block <- sum(sweep(expect_v, 2, expect_log_eta, "*") + sweep(1 - expect_v, 2, expect_log_one_minus_eta, "*")) + entropy_bern_d(expect_v);
    
    # E[log p(beta)] - E[log q(beta|delta)]
    mu_beta <- model$vparams$beta_delta$mu_beta;
    sigma2_beta <- model$vparams$beta_delta$sigma2_beta;
    beta_conditional_block <- sum(-0.5 * expect_delta * (tau * (mu_beta^2 + sigma2_beta) - 1 - log(tau * sigma2_beta)));
    
    # -E[log q(delta)]
    delta_variational_block <- entropy_bern_d(expect_delta);
    
    # Jensen lower bound for E[log p(delta|psi,phi)]
    expect_log_psi_matrix <- matrix(expect_log_psi, nrow = K, ncol = J);
    expect_log_one_minus_psi_matrix <- matrix(expect_log_one_minus_psi, nrow = K, ncol = J);
    expect_log_phi_matrix <- matrix(expect_log_phi, nrow = K, ncol = J, byrow = TRUE);
    expect_log_one_minus_phi_matrix <- matrix(expect_log_one_minus_phi, nrow = K, ncol = J, byrow = TRUE);
    H_xi_delta <- bern_h(xi_delta);
    
    delta_prior_block <- sum(expect_delta * (expect_log_psi_matrix + expect_log_phi_matrix) +
                               (1 - expect_delta) * (xi_delta * expect_log_one_minus_psi_matrix +
                                                       (1 - xi_delta) * expect_log_psi_matrix +
                                                       (1 - xi_delta) * expect_log_one_minus_phi_matrix + H_xi_delta));
    
    beta_delta_block <- beta_conditional_block + delta_variational_block + delta_prior_block;
    
    # E[log p] - E[log q] for Beta and Gamma variational factors
    psi_block <- beta_prior_minus_q(model$vparams$psi, alpha_psi, beta_psi);
    phi_block <- beta_prior_minus_q(model$vparams$phi, alpha_phi, beta_phi);
    eta_block <- beta_prior_minus_q(model$vparams$eta, alpha_eta, beta_eta);
    a_block <- gamma_prior_minus_q(model$vparams$a, alpha);
    
    total <- z_block + v_eta_block + beta_delta_block + psi_block + phi_block + eta_block + a_block;
    
    list(
      z = z_block,
      v_eta = v_eta_block,
      beta_delta = beta_delta_block,
      psi = psi_block,
      phi = phi_block,
      eta = eta_block,
      a = a_block,
      total = total
    )
  })
}

# variational evidence lower bound
elbo <- function(model) {
  elbo_components(model)$total
}

# append ELBO after one coordinate update
append_elbo_trace <- function(model, iteration, step, previous_elbo, verbose=1) {
  components <- elbo_components(model);
  current_elbo <- components$total;
  delta_elbo <- current_elbo - previous_elbo;
  
  if (delta_elbo < 0 && delta_elbo > -1e-10) {
    delta_elbo <- 0;
    current_elbo <- previous_elbo;
  }
  
  trace_row <- data.frame(
    iteration = iteration,
    step = step,
    elbo = current_elbo,
    delta = delta_elbo,
    z = components$z,
    v_eta = components$v_eta,
    beta_delta = components$beta_delta,
    psi = components$psi,
    phi = components$phi,
    eta = components$eta,
    a = components$a,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  );
  
  model$elbo_trace <- rbind(model$elbo_trace, trace_row);
  
  if (verbose >= 4) {
    message("delta elbo after ", step, ": ", delta_elbo);
  }
  
  list(model = model, elbo = current_elbo)
}
```

```{r}
# search.R

# search for a better local optimum

# get the final ELBO of a fitted model
final_elbo <- function(model) {
  if (length(model$elbo) > 0) {
    return(model$elbo[length(model$elbo)]);
  }

  elbo(model)
}

# sample a randomized ExprSim initialization
sample_model <- function(data, hparams) {
  if (!is(data, "exprsim_vi_data")) {
    data <- prepare_data(data)
  }

  N <- data$N
  J <- data$J
  K <- data$K

  psi <- rbeta(K, hparams$alpha_psi, hparams$beta_psi)
  phi <- rbeta(J, hparams$alpha_phi, hparams$beta_phi)
  edge_prob <- outer(psi, phi, "*")
  expect_delta <- matrix(rbinom(K * J, size=1, prob=as.vector(edge_prob)), nrow=K, ncol=J)
  mu_beta <- matrix(rnorm(K * J, mean=0, sd=1 / sqrt(hparams$tau)), nrow=K, ncol=J)
  sigma2_beta <- matrix(1 / hparams$tau, K, J)
  
  params0 <- list(expect_delta=expect_delta, mu_beta=mu_beta, sigma2_beta=sigma2_beta)
  make_model(data, params0, hparams)
}

# search over multiple ExprSim initializations
exprsim_vi_search <- function(data, hparams, n_starts=10, fixed=NULL, tol=1e-2, max.iter=2000, verbose=1, seed=NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) {
    set.seed(seed);
  }

  if (!is(data, "exprsim_vi_data")) {
    data <- prepare_data(data);
  }

  if (n_starts < 1) {
    stop("n_starts must be at least 1.");
  }

  search_elbo <- rep(NA, n_starts);

  # first fit: default initialization
  best_model <- exprsim_vi_local(
    data=data,
    hparams=hparams,
    fixed=fixed,
    verbose=if (verbose >= 4) verbose else 0,
    tol=tol,
    max.iter=max.iter
  );

  search_elbo[1] <- final_elbo(best_model);
  best_elbo <- search_elbo[1];
  best_start <- 1;

  if (verbose >= 2) {
    message("search start: 1,  elbo: ", search_elbo[1]);
  }

  # remaining fits: prior based random initializations
  if (n_starts > 1) {
    for (s in 2:n_starts) {
      initial_model <- sample_model(data, hparams);

      candidate_model <- exprsim_vi_local(
        model=initial_model,
        fixed=fixed,
        verbose=if (verbose >= 4) verbose else 0,
        tol=tol,
        max.iter=max.iter
      );

      candidate_elbo <- final_elbo(candidate_model);
      search_elbo[s] <- candidate_elbo;

      if (verbose >= 2) {
        message("search start: ", s, ",  elbo: ", candidate_elbo);
      }

      if (is.finite(candidate_elbo) &&
          (!is.finite(best_elbo) || candidate_elbo > best_elbo)) {
        best_model <- candidate_model;
        best_elbo <- candidate_elbo;
        best_start <- s;
      }
    }
  }

  best_model$search <- list(
    elbo = search_elbo,
    best_start = best_start,
    n_starts = n_starts
  );

  if (verbose >= 1) {
    message("best search start: ", best_start, ",  elbo: ", best_elbo);
  }

  best_model
}
```

```{r}
# fit VI to K562 subsample
k562 <- readH5AD("/Users/zhangrui/Desktop/precmat/K562_essential_raw_singlecell_01.h5ad", reader="R", use_hdf5=TRUE)

C <- assay(k562, "X")
rownames(C) <- as.character(rowData(k562)$gene_name)
ptb_raw <- as.character(colData(k562)$gene)

# remove zero-library-size cells
keep_cells <- Matrix::colSums(C) > 0
C <- C[, keep_cells, drop=FALSE]
ptb_raw <- ptb_raw[keep_cells]

genes <- rownames(C)
perts <- setdiff(sort(unique(ptb_raw)), c("control", "non-targeting"))

# subsample
set.seed(1)

N_use <- 300
J_use <- 200
K_use <- 40

# K regulators
regulator_gene_names <- intersect(perts, genes)
regulator_use <- sample(regulator_gene_names, K_use, replace=FALSE)

# J genes
other_gene_names <- setdiff(genes, regulator_use)
other_genes <- sample(other_gene_names, J_use - K_use, replace=FALSE)
genes_use <- c(regulator_use, other_genes)

# cell use = controls + selected perturbations
cell_pool <- which(ptb_raw %in% c("control", "non-targeting", regulator_use))
cells_use <- sample(cell_pool, min(N_use, length(cell_pool)), replace=FALSE)
pert_use <- ptb_raw[cells_use]

# N x J raw UMI count matrix
x <- as.matrix(t(C[genes_use, cells_use, drop=FALSE]))
storage.mode(x) <- "double"

N <- nrow(x)
J <- ncol(x)
K <- K_use

# check random subsample resembles whole dataset
cat("Zero proportion (whole)\n")
print(mean(C == 0))
cat("Zero proportion (subsample)\n")
print(mean(x == 0))
cat("Gene mean expression (whole)\n")
print(summary(Matrix::rowMeans(C)))
cat("Gene mean expression (subsample)\n")
print(summary(colMeans(x)))
cat("Cell mean UMI (whole)\n")
print(summary(Matrix::colMeans(C)))
cat("Cell mean UMI (subsample)\n")
print(summary(rowMeans(x)))

# perturbation indicator
u_indicator <- matrix(0, nrow=N, ncol=J, dimnames=list(NULL, genes_use))
for (k in seq_len(K)) {
  u_indicator[, k] <- as.numeric(pert_use == regulator_use[k])
}
```

```{r}
# generate hyperparameters
make_hparams <- function(settings) {
  list(
    gamma=settings$gamma, 
    rho=settings$rho, 
    alpha=settings$alpha, 
    tau=settings$tau,
    alpha_psi=settings$mu_psi * settings$lambda_psi,
    beta_psi=(1 - settings$mu_psi) * settings$lambda_psi,
    alpha_phi=settings$mu_phi * settings$lambda_phi,
    beta_phi=(1 - settings$mu_phi) * settings$lambda_phi,
    alpha_eta=settings$mu_eta * settings$lambda_eta,
    beta_eta=(1 - settings$mu_eta) * settings$lambda_eta
  )
}

# hyperparameter selection
hparams_select <- function(settings) {
  set.seed(123)

  # regulator-specific u_k applied to first K columns
  u <- u_indicator
  u[, seq_len(K)] <- sweep(u_indicator[, seq_len(K), drop=FALSE], 2, settings$u, "*")

  data_candidate <- list(x=x, u=u, K=K)
  hparams_candidate <- make_hparams(settings)

  fit_candidate <- tryCatch(
    exprsim_vi(data=data_candidate, hparams=hparams_candidate, tol=0.1, max.iter=100, verbose=0),
    error=function(e) {
      message("Candidate failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(fit_candidate)) {
    return(-Inf)
  }

  final_elbo(fit_candidate)
}

# search one scalar/vector hyperparameter(u) while holding others fixed
search_one_hparams <- function(settings, parameter, grid, stage) {
  for (k in seq_along(settings[[parameter]])) {
    if (parameter == "u" && sum(u_indicator[, k]) == 0) {
      settings$u[k] <- 0
      next
    }
    
    grid_k <- if (is.list(grid)) grid[[k]] else grid
    scores <- rep(-Inf, length(grid_k))

    for (g in seq_along(grid_k)) {
      candidate <- settings
      candidate[[parameter]][k] <- grid_k[g]
      cat(sprintf("  [%s] Evaluating %s[%d] = %g, ", Sys.time(), parameter, k, grid_k[g]))
      scores[g] <- hparams_select(candidate)
      cat(sprintf("ELBO = %.2f\n", scores[g]))
    }

    if (!any(is.finite(scores))) {
      stop("All candidates failed for ", parameter, "[", k, "].")
    }

    best <- which.max(scores)
    settings[[parameter]][k] <- grid_k[best]
  }

  cat(stage, ": best ", parameter, " = ", paste(round(settings[[parameter]], 3), collapse=", "), "\n", sep="")

  settings
}

# search mu and lambda for one Beta prior
search_hparams_beta <- function(settings, name, mu_grid, lambda_grid, stage) {
  grid <- expand.grid(mu=mu_grid, lambda=lambda_grid)
  scores <- rep(-Inf, nrow(grid))

  mu_name <- paste0("mu_", name)
  lambda_name <- paste0("lambda_", name)

  for (g in seq_len(nrow(grid))) {
    candidate <- settings
    candidate[[mu_name]] <- grid$mu[g]
    cat(sprintf("  [%s] Evaluating %s: mu = %g, lambda = %g, ", Sys.time(), name, grid$mu[g], grid$lambda[g]))
    candidate[[lambda_name]] <- grid$lambda[g]
    scores[g] <- hparams_select(candidate)
    cat(sprintf("ELBO = %.2f\n", scores[g]))
  }

  if (!any(is.finite(scores))) {
    stop("All candidates failed for ", name, ".")
  }

  best <- which.max(scores)
  settings[[mu_name]] <- grid$mu[best]
  settings[[lambda_name]] <- grid$lambda[best]

  cat(stage, ": best ", name, " mu = ", grid$mu[best], ", lambda = ", grid$lambda[best], ", ELBO = ", scores[best], "\n", sep="")

  settings
}

# hyperparameter grids
tau_grid <- c(700, 800, 900, 1000)
gamma_grid <- c(0.5, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2)
rho_grid <- c(15, 20, 25, 30)
u_grid <- c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9)
alpha_grid <- c(100, 120, 140, 160)
mu_grid <- c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9)
lambda_grid <- c(0.1, 1, 10, 100)

# initial values
settings <- list(tau=800, gamma=1, rho=20, u=rep(0.7, K), alpha=140,
                 mu_psi=0.5, lambda_psi=0.1, 
                 mu_phi=0.9, lambda_phi=0.1, 
                 mu_eta=0.7, lambda_eta=1)

# search for global hyperparameters that maximize ELBO
round <- 1
max_rounds <- 5

while (round <= max_rounds) {
  cat("\nGrid search round ", round, "\n", sep="")
  
  old_settings <- settings
  stage <- paste0("round_", round)

  settings <- search_one_hparams(settings, "tau", tau_grid, stage)
  settings <- search_one_hparams(settings, "gamma", gamma_grid, stage)
  settings <- search_one_hparams(settings, "rho", rho_grid, stage)
  settings <- search_one_hparams(settings, "alpha", alpha_grid, stage)
  settings <- search_hparams_beta(settings, "psi", mu_grid, lambda_grid, stage)
  settings <- search_hparams_beta(settings, "phi", mu_grid, lambda_grid, stage)
  settings <- search_hparams_beta(settings, "eta", mu_grid, lambda_grid, stage)

  if (identical(settings, old_settings)) {
    cat("\nGlobal hyperparameters converged after", round, "rounds.\n")
    break
  }
  
  round <- round + 1
}

if (round > max_rounds) cat("\nWarning: Grid search did not stabilize.\n")

# search for regulator specific u_k
cat("\nSearching regulator specific u_k:\n")
settings <- search_one_hparams(settings, "u", u_grid, "final_u")

# best hyperparameters
cat("\nBest settings:\n")
best_settings <- settings
print(best_settings)

cat("\nFinal hyperparameters:\n")
final_hparams <- make_hparams(best_settings)
print(final_hparams)

# final data using selected u
final_u <- u_indicator
final_u[, seq_len(K)] <- sweep(u_indicator[, seq_len(K), drop=FALSE], 2, best_settings$u, "*")
final_data <- list(x=x, u=final_u, K=K)

# final VI fit with different VI initializations
fit <- exprsim_vi_search(data=final_data, hparams=final_hparams, n_starts=5, tol=1e-2, max.iter=10000, verbose=2, seed=123)
print(fit)

# final ELBO
cat("\nBest final model start:\n")
print(fit$search$best_start)

cat("\nFinal ELBO:\n")
print(final_elbo(fit))

cat("\nLast 20 ELBO updates:\n")
print(tail(fit$elbo_trace, 20))

# plot actual ELBO for every variational step
no_initial <- subset(fit$elbo_trace, step != "initial")
p <- ggplot(no_initial, aes(x = seq_len(nrow(no_initial)), y = elbo, color = step)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), alpha = 0.3, color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, NA), breaks = function(x) setdiff(c(1, scales::extended_breaks()(x)), 0)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "ELBO by Variational Block", x = "Total Update Steps", y = "ELBO")
print(p)

cat("\nSaving...\n")
saveRDS(fit, "final_fit.rds")
ggsave("elbo.pdf", plot = p, width = 10, height = 6)
cat("All results saved.\n")
```
